description: Service public d'assainissement non collectif en Loire-Atlantique is a dataset listed in Loire-Atlantique - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de Loire-Atlantique. Localisation des Service public d'assainissement non collectif (SPANC). Les SPANC, créés par les communes ou collectivités compétentes, assurent le contrôle des installations d'assainissement non collectif. Coverage: Loire-Atlantique. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are assainissement autonome, traitement de l'eau, eau usée, implantation. The portal shows 22 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2012-02-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-loire-atlantique-fr-portal.
